context_notes: Phase 175 is the rehearsal-and-publish phase of the v23.0 milestone whose entire purpose is eliminating 'absence scored as success' — checks that pass green while asserting nothing. Wave 0 fixed one such defect (check-actions reported mutable_refs=0 while scanning ~12% of its scope; now files=27 actions=252 mutable_refs=0). Two MORE instances of the same defect class were found during wave 6 and are NOT yet fixed: (1) lockstep-truth fails unconditionally because its sed expects the x-release-please-version annotation on the same line as @version, but mix.exs has it on the line above — a vacuously RED check; (2) the Maven fire drill discards the Portal API's errors array, so it can report failure but never the reason. The rehearsal working as designed is the good news here: it caught a real Maven problem before the one-way door, which is exactly what it is for.
